_doc: Calibration scenario (docs/AGENT_FRAMEWORK.md section 4), run by scripts/calibration_run.py. Not loaded into the normal cfg (config.load_config skips this file), so ordinary run ids are unchanged. 'run' and 'overrides' are deep-merged into the normal config; 'scenario' becomes cfg['calibration'] (hashed into the run id). Everything random is drawn from run.seed and logged to calibration_forced.csv (t, agent_id, kind, detail).

extra_seeds._doc: n extra infections among members of Claude agents' friend groups, at uniform random times in [t_days[0], t_days[1]) days, so symptom onsets spread over the week. force_symptomatic makes them symptomatic (asym=false).

alerts._doc: n forced FlUni app alerts to random Claude agents at random times between hours[0] and hours[1] (local clock) on random days, each with one advice kind. Delivered through the intervention's actions, so llm_agents turns them into notifications and an app_advice re-plan. require_app=true picks only agents with the app.

severity_mix._doc: Peak severity for every infection of a member of a Claude agent's friend group (forced or natural) is drawn from these levels instead of disease.severity's Beta: level -> [peak severity, weight]. Asymptomatic infections stay at 0. null keeps the disease preset's Beta.

estimate._doc: Dry-run assumptions. Input tokens ~ chars / chars_per_token of system + user + JSON schema. The dry run's talk turns end after one line, so talk calls are scaled to turns_per_conversation. Output tokens per call (incl. adaptive thinking at effort low) are assumptions, not measurements; replace them with cost.json numbers after the first real run.

pricing._source: claude-api skill (Claude Code bundled skill 2.1.302), 'Current Models' table cached 2026-10-06 and shared/prompt-caching.md 'Economics'; read 2026-10-17. USD per million tokens, Claude API first-party rates. Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 cache reads ($0.20) are stated explicitly; cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute TTL). Haiku 5.5 cache prices are derived from the generic multipliers (1.25x write, ~0.1x read), not stated explicitly. Check https://claude.com/pricing before a large run.
